name: LValueData.theta_pairWeil_fockDatum
summary: Separate the Weil action into its real and finite parts and express θ of the Fock datum as a Gram form with the Schur jets.

steps.claim: The Weil action on an integrated datum splits into its real and finite parts (`pairWeil_integrated_all`); the theta functional of the Fock datum is a dot product with the Schur jets (`gramForm_apply`, `dotProduct_schurJet_mulVec`).
The real Weil action on the Schur coefficient polynomial is given by `realPairWeil_schurCoeffPoly` with `LValueData.harmonicPoly_eq_schurCoeffPoly`.
